title: Thor 4 Day V-Taper
author: Cody H.
desc: Unleash your inner strength with the Thor 4 Day V-Taper program, designed to sculpt your physique over 5 transformative weeks. This beginner-friendly routine focuses on building muscle and strength, utilizing a full gym setup to maximize your gains. Train four days a week with targeted workouts that emphasize creating a powerful V-taper silhouette. Get ready to elevate your fitness journey and achieve impressive results!
